name: Coinbase BTC/USD one-, ten-, and thirty-second momentum
description: Causal simple basis-point returns of the fresh Coinbase displayed best-quote midpoint over one, ten, and thirty one-second observations. direction_10s is down, flat, or up from the full-precision ten-second return. Any missing or stale one-second Coinbase midpoint observation breaks continuity and restarts the 30-second warm-up. This identity is single-venue: it reads only Coinbase inputs and is ready whenever the Coinbase midpoint ring holds at least 31 contiguous one-second samples, independently of the other adopted spot venue. The blended `btc.external.*` reading of the same measurement stays the reference layer and continues to require every adopted venue (ADR 0024). Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even.
